Question: Which of the following surveys is suitable for a census?

Choices.A: Finding out the lifespan of a batch of light bulbs
Choices.B: Finding out the weights of 45 students in a class
Choices.C: Finding out how audiences nationwide rate a particular film
Choices.D: Finding out the water quality of the Yangtze River

Solution: A census is suitable when there are very few subjects and measurements are easy to take. Testing the lifespan of light bulbs is destructive, while nationwide audiences and the water quality of the Yangtze River cover large scopes, so sampling is appropriate for these.
